title: noticeSchedule
description: The dated items of one notice group (umbrella ADR 0012 D3, D4; skkuverse-ai docs/explanation/notice-schedule-v2.md), stored as `schedule` on every copy of the group by the crawler's notices-schedule job (docs/notice-schedule/README.md). A notice without the field has no schedule yet; an empty `items` means the notice states no dated item. `run` is bookkeeping and is never served. Every date and time is Asia/Seoul wall time.

date.description: A calendar day, YYYY-MM-DD, in Asia/Seoul.

start.description: A point that begins a span: a day, a day and a time, or a range of days it can fall on (`latest`).

time.description: HH:MM, Asia/Seoul wall time. Absent when the notice gives no time.

latest.description: The last day the point can fall on, after `date`: "11월 말" is date 11-21, latest 11-30. Display text such as "11월 하순" is computed from the range.

end.description: A point that ends a span. As `start`, and its time may be 24:00: the end of that day, never 00:00 of the next.

time.description: HH:MM, Asia/Seoul wall time; 24:00 is the end of `date`.

rrule.description: An iCalendar RRULE from the item's start: every day, or each week's `byDay` days (the start's weekday when absent), until `until` or open. The item's start and end bound the first occurrence, as DTSTART and DTEND do.

gap.description: A partial-day stretch the item does not happen in, inside its span. iCalendar has no equivalent.

occurrence.description: An extra occurrence of the item (an iCalendar RDATE).

place.description: Either `id` and `campus` (the crawler's resolver pinned an SKKU place), or `reason` (none is pinned).

text.description: The place as the notice writes it, verbatim. Always shown.

id.description: A campus place id: space:{campus}:{spaceCd}, building:{campus}:{buildNo} or facility:{campus}:{slug}.

campus.description: The campus of `id`, or the campus a `campus_only` place names.

reason.description: Why no place id was pinned. `offcampus` and `online` are the schedule stage's reading of the place; the others are the resolver's answer for an SKKU place: `campus_only` names only a campus, `ambiguous` fits more than one place, `not_a_place` is not a place, `unknown_place` is an SKKU place the index lacks.

evidence.description: Where a value comes from in the notice.

from.description: The text it is in: the title, the body, or the poster numbered n in reading order.

for.description: `when`: a date expression; `status`: the words that show a status other than `scheduled`; `place`: the place words.

begin.description: The offset of `text` in that source.

id.description: Opaque, unique across the schedule's items and parts, and kept across the notice's edits: an edited notice's item keeps the id of the stored item with the same start and end (an end-only deadline matches on its end), else the same title. A part keeps the id of a part of the stored item its own item continues. Never reused for another item. The calendar UID is the notice's `dupOf` plus this id.

title.description: A short noun phrase in the notice's language, written by the schedule stage's model. Not verbatim.

status.description: A rescheduled item is the entry as it now stands, with its new date and place.

end.description: With `start`, the two bound the whole span, holes included, or the first occurrence when the item has `rrule`. Alone, the item is a deadline.

exdate.description: Whole days removed from the span or the series, sorted and unique.

parts.description: Agenda entries, each on one of the item's occurrence days and in time order; a part may carry its own `rrule` (several times a day across a span, as a shuttle timetable).

run.description: How the extraction that built `items` ran (skkuverse-ai app/schedule/model.py `Run`). The stage writes the fields up to `decided`; the crawler writes `missing`, `failures` and `nextTry`. Bookkeeping: never served.

repaired.description: The answer failed its form check once and was repaired.

warnings.description: Values the stage left out, and items its checks dropped.

unplaced.description: Rows that name no calendar day.

missed.description: Dates the model saw that the date list did not number.

decided.description: By D#, the resolver rule behind each value it changed, such as {"end": "order"}.

missing.description: The parts of the notice the items were built without, such as `poster:2`: the crawler's fetch of that poster kept failing, so the items lack what only that poster says.

failures.description: Failed attempts in a row when these items were stored; 0 when nothing is missing.

nextTry.description: When the crawler planned, as these items were stored, to try again with the missing parts; null when nothing is missing.

version.description: The skkuverse-ai schedule stage's version that built the items, such as `schedule-2`.

key.description: The stage's freeze key: crawler bookkeeping, sent back so an unchanged notice reuses its items. Not for readers.

groupId.description: The group key (trimmed title and contentHash) of the version the items were built from: crawler bookkeeping, the staleness stamp. Never key anything on it.

items.description: In time order: by start, else end, date, then time.
